title: Category of all small augmented polynomial algebras
statement: Fix the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. For a homomorphism $f:A\to B$ of $\mathcal U$-small commutative rings, let $\mathcal D_f$ be the full subcategory of augmented $A$-algebras $A\to T\to B$ whose composite is $f$ and for which there exist a $\mathcal U$-small set $E$ and an $A$-algebra isomorphism $A[E]\cong T$. Morphisms are all commuting $A$-algebra maps over $B$. No surjectivity of $T\to B$ is required. The category has objects in the containing universe; applying the canonical category universe lift makes it small there.

source.place: Tag 08PS, category construction preceding lemma-identify-pi-shriek, with all small variable sets in the containing universe.
